sheet.name: Dr Abdul Haqq Walid
sheet.backstory: Description: Abdul is a tall (182 cm/6-foot-ish), livelysome might say 'spry'-white Scotsman in his 50s, with a prominent forehead, a receding hairline, and ginger hair. Allegiances: aligned with Nightingale and the Folly. Traits: he speaks with a soft Scottish accent and has a dry sense of humour.
